title: Structure-Preserving Correction Learning for Sparse Bayesian Inference in Brain Source Imaging
abstract: arXiv:2606.07196v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Classical sparse Type-II Bayesian methods for M/EEG brain imaging support joint estimation of source and noise hyperparameters, but rely on fixed iterative update rules. Although these updates are principled and interpretable, their dynamics are not data-driven. We propose to learn the update mechanism itself while preserving the underlying Bayesian structure by unfolding a classical joint hyperparameter-learning solver into a trainable neural network architecture whose layers mirror the original iterations. The resulting framework is initialized to recover the classical solver exactly before training and is enriched through progressively more expressive residual correction learning mechanisms, ranging from learnable biases to adaptive multilayer perceptron and attention-based contextual refinements. translated_title: 脑源成像中稀疏贝叶斯推断的结构保持校正学习
translated_abstract: 经典的稀疏Type-II贝叶斯方法用于M/EEG脑成像，支持对源和噪声超参数的联合估计，但其依赖于固定的迭代更新规则。尽管这些更新规则具有原则性且可解释，但其动态过程并非数据驱动。我们提出通过将经典的联合超参数学习求解器展开为可训练的神经网络架构来学习更新机制本身，同时保持底层的贝叶斯结构，其中网络的各层对应于原始的迭代过程。该框架在训练前被初始化以精确恢复经典求解器的行为，并通过渐进式增强的残差校正学习机制加以丰富，涵盖从可学习偏差、自适应多层感知机到基于注意力的上下文精化等多种形式。通过这种方式，训练过程并非用黑盒预测器取代贝叶斯推断，而是学习结构化的校正项……
tldr: 该论文提出一种结构保持的校正学习框架，将经典的稀疏Type-II贝叶斯联合超参数求解器展开为可训练的神经网络，通过学习结构化的残差校正项以数据驱动的方式改进M/EEG脑源成像的推断性能，同时保留贝叶斯方法的可解释性。
